exactRepositoryDiff.change: Adds package script check:lifecycle:explorer-campaign-conformance, which generates the Lifecycle Explorer pack and runs its campaign-conformance check.

assessment.rationale: The only package.json delta is an external Lifecycle Explorer validation script. It adds no Media service endpoint, request/result schema, operation, identity/authority contract, or Media host handoff. The Media integration definition remains source-only and target-host-contract-pending, with integration consumers independently HOST_DEPENDENT and NOT_ADMITTED. The new script does not resolve or change that contract.
assessment.currentnessDisposition: The changed raw bytes are explicitly classified and the current Media surface declaration was rechecked. Include the R3 byte observation and this scoped impact assessment when evaluating PDP-3 R6; this assessment does not establish the 50-cell PDP-3 exit.
assessment.authorityBoundary: This is a Media source-impact assessment, not Lifecycle owner acceptance, runtime admission, external signature, or release qualification.
